i.norm: Encoding value 137 selects a "run codec" (values 117..140), whose decoding requires reading additional header bytes from the supplied input stream. When that stream is a {@link PipedInputStream} that has never been connected to a {@link java.io.PipedOutputStream}, the first read fails and getCodec propagates the resulting IOException ("Pipe not connected").
Reading from the unconnected pipe fails with "Pipe not connected".
